concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Data Acquisition & Merging (User Story 1, Priority P1)
concerns.text: The plan and data‑model reference a merge‑validation step (T018) that checks species‑ID and coordinate precision after ingestion. This task is absent from tasks.md, leaving a consumer (subsequent analysis steps) without its required producer. Add a T018 task before T017 to perform the merge validation and abort if >5 % mismatches.
